outputText:
assessment:
  role: "I2 API and TypeScript, with complete evidence synthesis"
  verdict:
    next_private_core_step: "NO-GO"
    after_admission_repair: "CONDITIONAL GO for a private normalized-value compiler only"
    public_package: "NO-GO"
    runtime_or_packed_conformance: "NO-GO"
    self_composition: "NO-GO"
  rationale: >-
    Accepted authority is detailed enough to implement a bounded, factory-free
    semantic compiler, but ADR-0015 requires an explicit governed owner-start
    record and enforcement; neither is present. No public API, production
    package, runtime, or current-SHA execution is authorized or proven.

custody:
  base_sha: "0f7d2fc64ae7258781e6c2676ca1e0ccc377f418"
  current_gm_sha: "3014239a0d22b21a3d2994fcc5f5b2da4e7e8236"
  input_bundle_sha256: "d93888d7a01fd438c4ca22035f872cb1c61e0c77ba0d92ce75345121b24ae532"
  historical_manifest_subject: "e0388dc6"
  dispute_subject: "2bef472612dea7c6a89199a47dd8ca7ed552e630"
  supplement_subject: "fe9611590dae25cdc22887148d685889daa0f7c6"
  retained_api_execution_source: "3155309a25edfd8d9dbb8b46e9c95259d9901357"
  verification: >-
    Current SHA and clean state are coordinator-supplied. This assessment used
    bounded read-only file inspection; no commands, tests, network access, or
    writes were performed.
  evidence_accounting:
    historical: "110 raw records; 97 unique; 13 aliases; 88 canonical roles; 9 attempts"
    statuses: "11 positive, 75 review-only, 5 source-unavailable, 4 partial, 2 blocked"
    supplement: "Six new read-only analyses; not votes and not runtime proof"
    canary: >-
      Demonstrates availability of bounded read_file/search_files and rejection
      of parent traversal. It does not establish OS-wide egress denial.

authority:
  controlling:
    - "Accepted ADR-0001 through ADR-0008 and ADR-0015"
    - "ARCH-SYSTEM-BOUNDARY, GM-REQ-V1, and digest-pinned V1 artifacts"
  proposed_only:
    - "ADR-0009 through ADR-0014 and ADR-0016"
  consequence: >-
    Core accepts inert declarations plus a complete profile and returns an
    immutable plan or bounded diagnostics. Factories, authorization, loading,
    construction, activation, lifecycle, readiness, generations, routing,
    drain, and recovery remain product-owned. Historical V1 labels and
    qualification fixtures cannot expand that boundary.

findings:
  - id: "ADM-01"
    severity: "P1"
    evidence:
      - "research/implementation-readiness/report.md:AUTH-01,GOV-01"
      - "ADR-0015"
      - "dispute critics T8-R1 through T8-R4"
    reproducible_impact: >-
      The required owner-start record is absent, and the admission checker does
      not reject an absent, stale, mismatched, or over-broad record. Tracked
      private Core source would therefore lack required authority.
    minimal_correction: >-
      Add the governed start record and enforce its exact scope before admitting
      source.
    owner_authority: "Product owner plus governance tooling owner"
    blocks_next_private_step: true

  - id: "GOV-02"
    severity: "P2"
    evidence: ["research/implementation-readiness/report.md:GOV-02"]
    reproducible_impact: >-
      Package-identity enforcement can disappear when the open-decision set
      becomes empty, permitting a later rogue package identity.
    minimal_correction: "Make private package identity and no-publication checks unconditional."
    owner_authority: "Governance tooling owner"
    blocks_next_private_step: false

  - id: "API-METRIC-01"
    severity: "P2"
    evidence:
      - "evidence/api-authoring-exact-run.json:genericGlueRatio"
      - "research/implementation-readiness/report.md:415-417"
      - "common/README.md:metric definitions"
    reproducible_impact: >-
      The reported 75.0%, 87.1%, and 82.8% values are
      totalSupportLoc/(authoringLoc+totalSupportLoc), not generic-glue or purely
      candidate-specific percentages. The current report label can mis-rank candidates.
    minimal_correction: "Rename the column to total support share and publish its denominator."
    owner_authority: "Qualification/report owner"
    blocks_next_private_step: false

  - id: "API-DTS-01"
    severity: "P2"
    evidence:
      - "common/run.mjs:257"
      - "common/candidate-define.ts:21"
      - "evidence/api-authoring-execution.json"
    reproducible_impact: >-
      S30 checks descriptorExample, defineModule, and splitDeclaration. It does
      not consume definedExample, so the broad declaration-emission guard proves
      file/export presence but not equivalent consumer-visible example types for
      every candidate.
    minimal_correction: >-
      Add packed consumer fixtures that import each authored declaration and
      assert literal, unknown-field, readonly/writable, and helper signatures.
    owner_authority: "Qualification owner; public typing remains a product decision"
    blocks_next_private_step: false

  - id: "API-ORACLE-01"
    severity: "P2"
    evidence:
      - "common/oracle.ts:ownerSegment and owner validation"
      - "common/corpus.ts:S21,S23"
      - "dispute critic T6-R2"
    reproducible_impact: >-
      The oracle accepts trailing or repeated hyphens and does not validate
      owner.authority. S21 now correctly rejects duplicate profile selections
      and six retained probes accept either alternative, but its stale title
      still says duplicate module IDs.
    minimal_correction: >-
      Mirror the accepted local-token grammar for authority and path; rename S21
      to duplicate profile selections.
    owner_authority: "Qualification fixture owner"
    blocks_next_private_step: false

  - id: "API-PARITY-01"
    severity: "P2"
    evidence:
      - "common/run.mjs:S28 host probe"
      - "dispute critics T7-R1 through T7-R4"
    reproducible_impact: >-
      directPureDiParity covers one required edge, one selected provider, the
      same two factories, hard-coded injection, and one string observation.
      Optional/many dependencies, replacement-controlled wiring, failure,
      lifecycle, rollback, and product adapters are absent.
    minimal_correction: "Rename it singleRequiredEdgePureDiSmoke; reserve parity for a real consumer."
    owner_authority: "Qualification owner and future Product Host owner"
    blocks_next_private_step: false

  - id: "QUAL-01"
    severity: "P1"
    evidence: ["research/implementation-readiness/report.md:QUAL-01"]
    reproducible_impact: >-
      The resource oracle has input-precedence, many-identification,
      numeric-cycle-depth, and raw-profile-byte omissions.
    minimal_correction: "Repair the pinned oracle and add boundary-order cases."
    owner_authority: "Qualification authority"
    blocks_next_private_step: false
    blocks: "Phase-3 qualification"

  - id: "QUAL-02"
    severity: "P1"
    evidence:
      - "research/implementation-readiness/report.md:QUAL-02"
      - "sources-fe96115/t2.result.json"
    reproducible_impact: >-
      Schema bounds min and max independently, while accepted semantics require
      0 <= min <= max and inclusive provider counts. No production compiler
      handoff proves this.
    minimal_correction: "Add full boundary vectors and execute them against the future subject."
    owner_authority: "Qualification authority"
    blocks_next_private_step: false
    blocks: "Phase-2/3 exit"

  - id: "SELF-01"
    severity: "P1"
    evidence: ["research/implementation-readiness/report.md:SELF-01,SELF-02"]
    reproducible_impact: >-
      Guidance mixes accepted ADR-0008 W0/W1 rules with proposal-only ADR-0016
      dependency-record and witness semantics.
    minimal_correction: "Restate ADR-0008 as controlling and quarantine proposal-only details."
    owner_authority: "Architecture owner"
    blocks_next_private_step: false
    blocks: "Self-composed/emitter claims"

contradictions_resolved:
  - >-
    B4's canonical result reported its narrow cases passing, but classifies the
    cycle as missing; it is not a full graph oracle. Its extra result is a retry,
    not corroboration.
  - >-
    Early T6 critics found alternative module declarations rejected. The current
    fixture indexes implementation IDs, rejects repeated selections, and retains
    six positive single-alternative probes; only the S21 title remains stale.
  - >-
    T2-R3 recommended own-data min/max. Supplemental t2 correctly observes that
    inherited ordinary reads are explicitly accepted by ADR-0007; changing that
    requires a successor ADR.
  - >-
    Historical integrators ranged from CONDITIONAL to NO-GO. Later ADR-0015 and
    the still-missing owner-start/enforcement govern the current NO-GO.
  - >-
    Worker/model counts do not select descriptor, defineModule, split syntax, or
    any public API.

phase_readiness:
  - { phase: "Admission", status: "NO-GO", gate: "ADM-01" }
  - { phase: "Declarations/profile", status: "Conditionally specified", gate: "Owner-start first; private normalized values only" }
  - { phase: "Normalization/graph", status: "Not qualified", gate: "Real subject, QUAL-01/02, full SCC oracle" }
  - { phase: "Plan/digest", status: "Not qualified", gate: "Immutability, alias/clone, reversed-many, cross-process proof" }
  - { phase: "Packed portability", status: "NO-GO", gate: "Exact archive and six required consumer cases" }
  - { phase: "Self-composition", status: "NO-GO", gate: "SELF-01/02 and executable witness evidence" }
  - { phase: "Product runtime", status: "NO-GO", gate: "Consumer-owned factory/failure/lifecycle decisions" }
  - { phase: "Public/publication", status: "NO-GO", gate: "Proposed ADRs unresolved; no public package" }

api_candidate_comparison:
  retained_scope: >-
    One source-bound execution: 30 identical scenarios x 3 candidates = 90
    cells; six alternative selections; 18 before/after edits across 36 trees.
    This was not rerun at the current documentation SHA.
  common_edits: "file loci by action: add 4, rebind 1, remove+replace 4, remove-unrepaired 3, disable-required 1, disable-optional 1"
  candidates:
    - name: "Descriptor object"
      loc: "4 authoring; 11 generic; 1 candidate; 12 total support; 75.0% support share"
      declarations: "181 bytes; 3 lines; 2 exports"
      assessment: "Best canonical inert/internal representation; weakest inference facade."
    - name: "defineModule"
      loc: "4 authoring; 11 generic; 16 candidate; 27 total support; 87.1% support share"
      declarations: "543 bytes; 19 lines; 6 exports"
      assessment: >-
        Preferred bounded authoring facade because it preserves literals and
        returns the exact reference. Its generic also preserves authorNote-like
        extra fields while wire validation rejects unknown fields; exact
        unknown-field typing and readonly versus mutable declarations remain
        product/public-surface decisions.
    - name: "Split declaration/factory"
      loc: "5 authoring; 11 generic; 3 candidate; 10 factory-association; 24 total support; 82.8% support share"
      declarations: "338 bytes; 5 lines; 4 exports"
      assessment: >-
        Valid only with factory association remaining product-owned.
        associateFactory checks literal identity and runtime mismatch in two
        host probes, but is disposable fixture code—not a Core or public helper.
  conclusion: >-
    Use canonical descriptors internally and, if authorized later, the accepted
    thin defineModule helper for authoring. Keep factories entirely separate in
    the Product Host. This is not a public API selection.

packed_consumer_gates:
  - "NodeNext, Bundler, JavaScript/checkJs inference, helper runtime, and real compiler handoff"
  - "1,000-declaration benchmark with comparable workloads"
  - "Exact packed archive on Node 24 Linux/macOS/Windows, Chromium window/worker, and Electron desktop"
  - "Consumer-visible declaration tests for all candidates"
  - "Tree-shaking and runtime performance remain not measured"

oss_lessons:
  - { source: "sources-fe96115/o1 VS Code", transfer: "Separate resolution from activation; literal authorized loaders", reject: "Executable discovery in Core" }
  - { source: "o2 Theia", transfer: "Host-owned lifecycle and filtered contributions", reject: "Container/registration order as semantics" }
  - { source: "o3 Equinox", transfer: "Explicit lifecycle failure and refresh ownership", reject: "Mutable resolver/container in Core" }

  - { source: "o5 Avvio", transfer: "Dependency ordering and bounded host errors", reject: "Plugin boot/timeout lifecycle in Core" }

future_implementation_blockers:
  - "No production compiler subject or current-SHA execution"
  - "Full semantic/resource/cardinality vectors and deterministic SCC diagnostics"
  - "Plan immutability and canonical digest proof"
  - "Packed portability matrix and declaration-consumer coverage"
  - "Self-composition emitter/witness qualification"
  - "Real Product Host selected-only loading, factory preflight, failure, cleanup, and recovery"

unresolved_product_decisions:
  - "ADR-0009 public namespace/API; no model-vote selection"
  - "ADR-0010 production primitives and ADR-0011 release custody"
  - "OD-004/ADR-0012 carrier and OD-005/ADR-0013 raw-input trust"
  - "OD-006/ADR-0014 repeated binding records"
  - "ADR-0016 dependency record and construction witness"
  - "Unknown-field exactness and readonly/writable TypeScript authoring surface"
  - "Resource/schema precedence, diagnostic path clipping, cycle-depth suppression"
  - "Product factory binding, exceptions, partial construction, readiness, rollback, and recovery"

minimal_dependency_safe_next_task:
  scope: "Phase-0 admission repair only"
  actions:
    - "Create the governed, narrowly scoped ADR-0015 owner-start record."
    - "Make admission fail on missing, stale, mismatched, or broader scope."
    - "Always enforce the allowed private package identity, private exports, and no-publication boundary."
  exclusions: "No package, Core source, API, carrier, framework, runtime, fixture semantics, or ADR-status change."
